tickets.text: The trigger is unchanged: h1_close_above:bar_high carries no pivot cap, and with pct_from_pivot 5.09 it fires as a late buy past pivot_high +5pct (C17). LEADER on day_vol 2.72 is real; the entry is not.
R4: day_vol 1.2 fails the C16 breakout bar. LEADER with BULLISH_BOS and D HH/HL 0.45% under the 20-day high is real, but a breakout nobody bought is not my buy.
R2: rs_leadership IN-LINE fails C9/C10; R4: day_vol 0.68 fails C16. W HH/HL 1.9% under the 20-wk high is trend, not a leader's volume breakout.
The trigger fires on any volume. day_vol 1.59 passes R4 today, but the hourly break it buys is not volume-tested, and lens coil -- leaves the base uncounted (R3); the ticket does not say so.
R7 climax: entry 116.84 against ma_200 67.78 is more than 70% above the 200-day; C24 sells into that, never buys it. No base under it: ABOVE_STRUCTURE, coil warn.
R4: day_vol 1.26 is under the C16 breakout bar; coil -- leaves no countable base (R3). D red bar 2.87% under the 20-day high, H1 below EMA9 at 21.9% of range: no breakout today. Leadership is real.
R4: day_vol 0.81 fails C16; coil -- leaves no countable base (R3). W 6.13% and D 3.16% under the 20-bar high: not a new high out of a base (C7).
No base: ABOVE_STRUCTURE, coil warn (R3). On day_vol 1.58 the H1 closed at 14.0% of the day's range with LH/LL and D red: heavy volume closing near the low is C25's distribution warning.
The pivot clear is the breakout bar itself, and the trigger lets it fire on any volume; under C16 a breakout under +40% volume is a hard rejection. Base uncounted (coil --).
